latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the baoyu-post-to-weibo-2 skill.

- Added 117 scripts and vendor files for posting to Weibo via Chrome CDP.
- Supports posting regular text, images, and videos to Weibo.
- Supports publishing headline articles (Markdown) with image/cover support.
- Includes clipboard utility scripts for robust content transfer.
- Vendor code for Chrome CDP and Markdown processing is bundled within.
